_comment: Proposed editorial dispositions for issue #571. Original automated scan remains unchanged. Deferred rows require further product-specific verification. No roster or verdict changes.

dispositions.name: Aider → speech-to-text
dispositions.reason: The linked recording demonstrates a coding-assistant slash-command change. Recording playback is not a speech-to-text API.

dispositions.name: Airwallex → fp-a
dispositions.reason: The page describes expense-policy enforcement and spend management. It does not establish financial forecasting, scenario models or board reporting required for FP&A.

dispositions.name: Google Antigravity → docs-platforms
dispositions.reason: The linked page is an agent installation guide. A product having documentation does not make it a documentation authoring and publishing platform.

dispositions.name: Baseten → agent-frameworks
dispositions.reason: The cited launch is hosted Beam model availability, not a new agent framework. The changelog fetch returned a JavaScript-only shell; the issue excerpt is retained as historical evidence. Baseten Chains has separate inference-pipeline docs; assess that separately if nominated.
evidence: https://www.baseten.co/resources/changelog/beam-10-available-on-baseten/ — reviewed 2026-11-04; JavaScript shell only; historical headline from issue #571.

dispositions.name: Claude → self-hosted-assistants
dispositions.reason: The launch describes a hosted model/API and subscriptions, without evidence of an open-source assistant runtime runnable with user-owned infrastructure.

dispositions.name: GitHub Copilot → durable-workflows
dispositions.reason: The launch compiles Markdown automation into GitHub Actions. It does not establish checkpointed execution and exact failure resumption required by the durable-workflows definition.

dispositions.name: GitHub → durable-workflows
dispositions.reason: This is the same launch URL as the GitHub Copilot row. It does not establish checkpointed durable execution; retain the two identities in the audit without duplicating a bring-up.

dispositions.name: Groq → frontier-models
dispositions.reason: The source credits Meta with developing Llama 3 and describes Groq hosting it. This does not establish Groq as the frontier model developer. The page dates to April 2024.

dispositions.name: Groq → llm-evals-observability
dispositions.reason: The source is inference hosting, not tracing, evaluation or observability software. Its April 2024 date also makes it unsuitable as a current launch.

dispositions.name: Mastra → ai-code-review
dispositions.reason: Span Queries filters and aggregates execution traces. Letting a coding agent consume those traces does not establish an autonomous PR review product.

dispositions.name: Mastra → ai-coding
dispositions.reason: The cited Agent Controller is a general session runtime, but the full article also identifies Mastra Code as a coding agent. Defer generic Mastra roster placement: assess the named Mastra Code product and install/docs surface separately rather than dismiss this as having no coding relevance.

dispositions.name: Mastra → ai-memory
dispositions.reason: The article establishes persistent company/team context and distinguishes Knowledge from Mastra memory. Plausible AI-memory fit, but access is limited to design partners. Defer until a usable install/signup and technical docs are verified; do not label this a lexical false positive.
